verdict.rationale: Context.dev is an API-first product with an official CLI documented for terminal use "in scripts or CI" with JSON output. It also offers TypeScript and Python SDKs and scoped API keys for integrations, so headless automation is a core, first-party capability. Missing for 10: detailed CI setup documentation (e.g., non-interactive auth via env vars, pipeline examples) and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Call Context.dev from your terminal and use JSON responses in scripts or CI.
Choose **Restricted** when an integration needs only selected operations
